text:
noelle: Quick sync — I'm starting a short cleanup sprint for docs migration + glossary naming. Need to settle terminology around 'model variant' vs 'model replica' before Monday. PRs to watch: #452, #457, #460. Can folks glance today? cc @sam @alex

sam: On it. Which meaning do we want: 'variant' = different checkpoints/configs, 'replica' = runtime copies?

priya: I prefer 'variant' for anything users pick (checkpoints/config). Avoid 'replica' in public docs cause it sounds like DB replicas.

alex: :thumbsup: Agreed. I'll update the Python SDK snippets to use model_variant / model_variant_id and push a PR with tiny tests.

noelle: Thanks — also found a stale link in the migration guide pointing to the old embeddings page. Should be updated to the batch embeddings endpoint.

noelle: Old link: https://docs.redwood.inference/migrate/old-embeds -> New: https://docs.redwood.inference/migrate/embeddings-batch

dev-bot: CI: build passed for branch alex/sdk-variant-fix (✅) https://ci.internal/build/8342

alex: Pushed the snippet changes. Two small examples updated. Snippets below for reference:

```python
# python snippet (SDK v2)
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
resp = client.generate(model_variant_id="gpt-3.5-mini:variant-a", input="Summarize the doc")
print(resp.output)
```

```javascript
// js snippet (SDK v2)
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
const resp = await client.generate({ modelVariantId: 'gpt-3.5-mini:variant-a', input: 'Summarize the doc' })
console.log(resp.output)
```

sam: I'll update the glossary entry. Proposal: keep 'replica' but mark it as "internal/runtime" and add a redirect from any public pages that accidentally use it.

priya: +1. Make the glossary note explicit: "Users should use 'model variant' in public-facing docs; 'replica' is an internal runtime term." Add the link to the naming doc too.

noelle: Let's batch the link fixes into PR #460 and do a canary merge tomorrow. Standup pairing on the migration guide at 11:00am PST tomorrow — if you can't make it, leave comments on #460. Also audit the examples/ folder for inconsistent param names (model vs model_id vs model_variant_id).

alex: Good call. Found some examples still using model='gpt-2' — per SDK v2 we should use model_id or modelVariantId. I'll grep the repo and open fixes.

sam: Will do a repo-wide search and open small PRs for each mismatch.

priya: :eyes: I'll proofread the migration doc after the link fixes and glossary update. Thanks everyone!

noelle: Awesome — thanks team. If anyone picks up a PR ping here so we don't overlap. :sparkles:
